name: Jhajjar–Bahadurgarh National Highway
significance: NH 352R is a branch of NH 352. In the national highway numbering used since 2010, a letter after the number marks a spur or link off the main route — this one runs Jhajjar to Bahadurgarh, and it meets NH 352 along the way.

relatedRoads.label: NH 352 — the highway this branch takes its number from, running Rohtak to Rewari
